### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **4** package(s): `@objectstack/formula`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `@objectstack/service-messaging`, touching **37** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/formula/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`  _(via bodyHtml (literal, a string literal in FACES), bodyText (literal, a string literal in FACES), emailTemplates (literal, a string literal in validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar), email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`  _(via email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object), runtimeTypes (symbol, a field of const object AUTHORING_RULES), email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/quick-start.mdx`  _(via emailTemplates (literal, a string literal in validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx`  _(via email_template (literal, a string literal in runtimeTypes))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/formula/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **14** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **23** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `648b5552aeba2224a365c508effb98de0d3c34b2` — the merge of head `898b6a1fe1cf57c1663fb88b4229f853616e4ec6` into base `aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 648b5552aeba2224a365c508effb98de0d3c34b2 && git checkout 648b5552aeba2224a365c508effb98de0d3c34b2
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc 898b6a1fe1cf57c1663fb88b4229f853616e4ec6 && git checkout -B drift-repro aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc && git merge --no-ff 898b6a1fe1cf57c1663fb88b4229f853616e4ec6

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs aeb9cf0ddc3233ca0c2dbb2c05fc91534a6b13bc` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `dfe802626637eacda4e689a2972aa3733b4276a3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/formula/src/index.ts, packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts, packages/formula/src/mail-html-hole-placement.ts, packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts, packages/formula/src/template-hole-grammar.test.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-writes.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/inbox-channel.test.ts, packages/services/service-messaging/src/inbox-channel.ts + packages/formula/src/validate.ts, packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts, packages/lint/src/collection-entries.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-placements.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/index.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts, ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts, skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md, examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/renewals-pipeline.page.ts

Face: the file list carries no schema and no governed path, so the recogniser reads the face off the changesets' `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line (it refuses `--paths` here and names that line); the floor is every path of the diff outside the prose faces. Inputs: cards #26660 and #26673 with every comment (triage `6441491903` and `6442560667`, claims `6445327635` and `6445353774`, both `os-dev-report`s `6447779926` and `6449628305`, the claim amendment `6447835110`), the PR body and file list, the net diff against `main` at the merge-base, and the check-runs on the head. Four packages publish; `.changeset/*`, `content/docs/**` and the four CLI transcripts are read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set changes the diff implies — each named RIGHT or WRONG against the tree.

1. **`email_template` `subject` / `bodyText` / `bodyHtml`: a hole with a second `|` outside a closed single-quoted argument is refused** at `os validate` / `build` / `lint` and at the `email_template` runtime publish door (`422 INVALID_METADATA`), rule `email-template-hole-grammar`. RIGHT — the refusal triage `6442560667` asked for, naming the one-formatter rule and the caller remedy. A chain whose first formatter does not match the mail `FILTER_RE` (`{{ x | upper | lower }}`) used to be left on the page verbatim by the renderer; it is now a refused hole (`parseMailHole` judges the chain rule on `!m`), declared in the lint changeset. RIGHT.
2. **Same faces: `currency:ARG` with `ARG` not three capitals is refused** — a path, a dotted path, an empty argument, `EURO`, a lowercase code, and a double-quoted code (the mail `FILTER_RE` never stripped double quotes, so `currency:"EUR"` hands `"EUR"` to the judge; before, `Intl` refused it and USD printed). RIGHT — triage `6441491903`: "Refuse it at template save until it is supported… never a silent default currency". One arm goes beyond the cards' defect: `Intl` accepts a lowercase well-formed code (`IsWellFormedCurrencyCode` uppercases), so `currency:eur` as a literal rendered in euros before and is refused now. It is declared as "three capital letters" in all three changesets, the docs page and the refusal sentence, and one literal spelling of an ISO 4217 code is the right grammar; judged RIGHT, with the changeset wording finding in ②.
3. **The in-app `template` dialect refuses the same two shapes at compile** (`templateEngine.compile` / `evaluate`; `validateExpression('template', …)` reports `invalid-template`, `packages/formula/src/validate.ts:963`). A narrowing beyond mail templates. Every in-repo caller of that compile path and every slot it serves, read at the head: `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts:2804` and `:3554` and `validate-action-copy-templates.ts:129` (action `confirmText` / `successMessage` on object, page and bulk actions; flow text slots), `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-registration-checks.ts:619` (`registerFlow`), `service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts:122` (`renderTextSlot` for notify `title` / `message` — a hole that does not compile already throws `FlowTextTemplateError`, the pre-existing fail policy), `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionCopyTemplate.ts:93` (`fillTemplateHoles` — a refused sentence is shown as written, pre-existing fail-soft), plus `Object.titleFormat` and `promptTemplate` per `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:444`. Sweep of every tree at the head (`packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `apps`, `ui`, `docs`): zero chained holes (the one regex hit is a JSX `style` object, `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/renewals-pipeline.page.ts:112`); every `currency:` hole argument is `EUR` or `'USD'` (docs, spec describe text, ui tests, plugin-email pin). No shipped template, example or test fixture is refused. RIGHT.
4. **`formatValue('currency', value, arg)` throws `RangeError` for a non-code `arg` instead of substituting USD**, before the value is read (a non-numeric value with a bad argument used to print the raw string; now throws — pinned on purpose). Who calls it with a non-ISO argument today: the only non-test caller of formula's `formatValue` in the repository is the mail renderer (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts:128`), which now judges the hole first; the in-app `evaluate` judges at compile; every `formatValue` in `ui/` is a local function of that name, not the formula export. Nobody passes a non-ISO argument. RIGHT.
5. **`EmailService.sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate` throw `TEMPLATE_INVALID: email template NAME (locale=L): …`** for a stored template the grammar refuses, and send nothing. One door: the only render call sites in `email-service.ts` are inside `resolveAndRenderTemplate` (`:1472-1475`), and `renderTemplate` / `renderPlainTextTemplate` are not on the package entry (`index.ts:88-93`), so the name-and-locale prefix is never missing. RIGHT.
6. **`service-messaging` email and inbox channels grade `TEMPLATE_INVALID` permanent** (word-boundary match on the message's leading code). RIGHT — the ruling-A half the seat authorized in `6447835110`.
7. **Unchanged, declared:** `currency` with no argument still formats in USD; other formatter arguments stay unjudged; an unknown formatter still renders the raw value.

Public-surface changes (additive): `@objectstack/formula` exports `judgeHoleFormatter`, `mailHolePattern`, `parseMailHole`, `judgeMailHoleGrammar` and the types `TemplateHoleGrammarRefusal`, `TemplateHoleGrammarRule`, `ParsedMailHole`, `MailHoleGrammarFinding`; `@objectstack/lint` exports `validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar`, `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLE_GRAMMAR`, `EmailTemplateHoleGrammarFinding` and publishes the rule id `email-template-hole-grammar` (`AUTHORING_RULES` 54 → 55, the four transcripts match `origin/main`'s 54 → the head's 55). RIGHT.

**Exactly one mail hole grammar.** `packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts` holds the pattern and `FILTER_RE` (byte-identical to the renderer's former regex); `plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts` and `formula/src/mail-html-hole-placement.ts` dropped their copies and import it; `packages/lint/src` keeps none (its `\{\{` regexes in `lint-flow-patterns.ts` and `validate-flow-template-paths.ts` are the in-app flow dialect's, not mail); the plugin-email pin `text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts` reads `judgeMailHtmlHoles` from formula. The in-app dialect keeps its own `HOLE_RE` / `PATH_ONLY_RE` — two dialects by design, one shared judgement (`judgeHoleFormatter`), no cycle (`mail-hole-grammar.ts` imports `template-engine.ts`, never the reverse).

### ② Semver level

Four changesets, read against what the diff publishes:

- `@objectstack/formula` **minor** — `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, BREAKING banner, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. RIGHT: the in-app hole grammar is spec-documented (`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:470` spells `{{ amount | currency:EUR }}` and `formatter[:arg]`), so a refused value is `narrowed`, and `narrowed` takes `minor` on a package the diff moves.
- `@objectstack/plugin-email` **minor** — `no (narrowing)`, `narrowed`, BREAKING, same marker. RIGHT (a stored value the renderer now refuses).
- `@objectstack/lint` **minor** — `no (narrowing)`, `narrowed`, BREAKING, same marker. RIGHT. Observation: the precedent of this exact shape, the placement rule (`packages/formula/CHANGELOG.md:136-143`), declared `Metadata-protocol: none` and shipped `patch`; this PR's `narrowed` follows the AGENTS.md definition ("a value refused or a requirement tightened") and takes the higher level. Not a finding.
- `@objectstack/service-messaging` **patch** — `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. RIGHT: a grade change only.
- `Check Changeset` and the ADR-0087 registration gate are green on the head; the PR body carries the same two lines.

Two should-fix findings on changeset prose (level unaffected):

- **S1** — `.changeset/26660-mail-hole-grammar-formula.md:13` says `formatValue('currency', value, ARG)` "throws a `RangeError` for such an `ARG` instead of formatting in US dollars". True for a path or `EURO`; false for the lowercase arm, which `Intl` formatted correctly before (see ① item 2). The narrowing is declared; its before-account is wrong for one of the arms it names. Reword the sentence (the lint changeset's "A lowercase or empty argument is refused the same way" is the accurate shape).
- **S2** — all three narrowing changesets end their `Clause-②` line with "Nothing is widened". Read as "no accept set is widened" that is true; the diff does add the exports listed in ①, which `minor` already carries. Either name them as additive in the body or spell the line `yes (narrowing)`, the arm the reader defines for "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another". The precedent (#25189) used `no (narrowing)` for the same shape and both gates accept it, so this is wording, not a FAIL.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag, deviation and `open_questions` entry, answered:

- **Landing beyond the claim's named files** (lint rule, metadata-protocol test, four transcripts): the claim allowed the lint rule "if that is the producer"; measured, it is (`runtime-gate.ts:190` maps `email_template` → `emailTemplates`); the seat amended the claim in `6447835110`. Answered.
- **In-app dialect narrows too**: judged in ① item 3 and ④ — held; the sweep finds nothing refused in any tree.
- **`Part of #26660` rather than `Refs #26660 (item c)`**: PR-body guards green; the triage ruling on item (b) ("a record path … widens the template grammar … comes back to triage") is honoured — not built, the card stays open, the acceptance note says so. Answered.

Round 2 `open_questions`: none.
- **PR body edits** named in the delta report (the `@objectstack/service-messaging` bullet, the tests bullet, the `TEMPLATE_INVALID` acceptance note naming #26803, "87" → "86", the patch-round details, the `Commits:` line): all six are applied in the current body.
- **Serial #25805** (`packages/lint`): still open with no PR; `origin/main` reads 54 on the transcripts and in `AUTHORING_RULES`, the head 55 — consistent today; whichever lands second re-counts, and `check:docs-transcript-drift` sits in the required `Lint & Repo Gates`, so the queue catches it. Escalation: none needed.
- **Out-of-scope findings** (the no-argument USD default, other formatter arguments unjudged): carried on #26660 and in the acceptance notes; neither is a defect this diff introduces.
- **Governance**: no governed path in the file list; head repo is the base repo; 962 + 104 changed lines; draft. Check-runs on `dfe80262`: all nine required contexts success (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` 8/8, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`; `Lint UI` skipped by the path selector); every advisory success or skipped; the second `Check Changeset` run (PR Automation, `pull_request`) completed success.

### ④ Design judgment

Per floor file, against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against (cards #26660 item (c) and #26673: hotclm's `{{ planned_amount | currency:currency_code }}` with `currency_code = 'eur'`, and `{{ actual_amount | default:0 | number:2 }}`, in subject, text and html), read in the tree, tried to break:

- **`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts`** — `judgeHoleFormatter` probed by hand: `default:0 | number:2` (colon arm, argument carries `|`) refused; `upper | lower` (no colon) refused; `default:'a | b'` admitted; `default:'a' | upper` refused (text after the closing quote); an unclosed quote `default:'a | b` refused; `number:2|upper` refused; `currency:'USD'` and `currency: EUR` admitted; `currency:`, `currency:eur`, `currency:EURO`, `currency:record.currency_code` refused. The formatter and the judge share `isCurrencyCode`, so a hole the judge admits never throws at the formatter, and a well-formed three-capital non-currency (`XYZ`) is well-formed for `Intl` too — no throw. In the in-app `parseHole` the one-formatter refusal is returned before the `FORMATTERS[name]` lookup, so `upper | lower` gets the rule's sentence rather than "unknown formatter"; `compileTemplate` answers `kind: 'parse'`, which `validate.ts` turns into `invalid-template`; `evaluate` compiles first, so the formatter throw is a backstop only. Holds.
- **`packages/formula/src/mail-hole-grammar.ts`** — `parseMailHole` returns `null` for non-path text exactly as the renderer's old `parseHole` did (verbatim, unchanged); on `!m` it judges only the chain rule (name from a split on `[:|]`), so `{{ x | foo-bar }}` stays verbatim as before; `mailHolePattern()` is a fresh `RegExp` per caller — no shared `lastIndex` between the renderer's `replace`, the judge's `matchAll` and the rule. `judgeMailHoleGrammar` returns offset, text and refusal in face order. Holds.
- **`packages/formula/src/mail-html-hole-placement.ts`** — copy removed; `judgeMailHtmlHoles` now also sees a chained hole whose first formatter did not parse (it used to skip it), consistent with the renderer that now refuses it; such a hole in an unsupported placement draws the placement finding as well, both `error`. The plugin-email pin holds the judge's spans to the renderer's. Holds.
- **`packages/formula/src/index.ts`** — the exports in ①; no cycle. Holds.
- **`packages/formula/src/template-hole-grammar.test.ts`** — both rules through the judge, each dialect's door, the formatter backstop (throws for `null` too), and the mail grammar's parse and per-face judge; every refusal pinned on its rule and sentence beside a non-vacuous admit. Holds.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts` and `authoring-rules.ts`** — the same shape as the placement rule: `collectionEntries` (array and name-keyed), `tier: 'gating'`, `commands: ALL`, `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, `runtimeTypes: ['email_template']`; all three faces judged with the renderer's own pattern (the renderer applies `mailHolePattern()` to every face, so the rule's holes are the renderer's holes); finding path `emailTemplates[i].face`, message names the face, the hole and the offset. Holds.
- **`packages/lint/src/index.ts`** — the rule id is on the barrel for `--json` consumers. Holds.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.test.ts`** — the rule per face, the registry entry, each `os` command at `error`, the runtime gate on a written template. Holds.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-writes.test.ts`** — through the shipped `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate`, asserting `code` + `status` + `issues` + `rulesRun`, each with a non-vacuous admit. Holds.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`** — copy removed; the refusal is thrown before any lookup or format, so neither formatter syntax nor a substituted currency can reach a recipient; unknown formatter still raw; `requireVars` untouched. Holds.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`** — the wrap rethrows every non-`TEMPLATE_INVALID` error unchanged (the `MISSING_VARIABLES` path above it is untouched) and prefixes the template and the resolved row's locale. Holds.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts`** — the cards' two bodies through `renderTemplate` and `sendTemplate`, every face, for `null` and `71100`, refused with the prefix and the rule; nothing sent; the admits render `€1,234.50` and `$1,234.50`. Holds.
- **`packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts`, `inbox-channel.ts` and their tests** — the word joins the permanent vocabulary; one pin per channel reads the code off the delivery row and asserts `permanent`. Holds.
